_comment: Copy to /etc/unifi-allowlist/admin-ui.json (mode 640). Holds ADMIN_KEY; never commit it. Set the password with set-password.js; it fills passwordHash and sessionSecret.
_listen: Interface to bind. 0.0.0.0 = every interface on the machine; or a single LAN or Tailscale address.
_behindTls: true when Caddy, nginx or Tailscale Serve terminates HTTPS in front of this, so the session cookie gets the Secure flag.
